story: Home room tour 20 s. Why: the corner where she reads every morning. The camera walks in from the door, circles to the chair, studies the fabric and legs, someone sits down with a book; ends as the afternoon light turns golden.
storyboard_prompt: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal wide 16:9 photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Every panel: Interior room tour, 16:9 frame, 24mm lens at chest height, a slow steady gimbal move with a little handheld drift. The room keeps exactly the same walls, window, floor and furniture throughout. a calm Scandinavian living room: white walls with a small crack near the skirting, a large window on the LEFT with linen curtains, light oak floorboards with a few scratches, a jute rug, a potted fiddle-leaf fig, a small side table with a stack of books and a mug; the armchair stands in the corner by the window. The armchair: a mid-century wingback armchair upholstered in a jacquard fabric with a repeating oval eye pattern in grey, taupe and cream, piped seams, a loose seat cushion, a walnut wood plinth base and four tapered walnut legs with brass tips. Panel 1 (top left): from the doorway: the whole sunlit room, the armchair small in the far corner by the window, morning light across the floor. Panel 2 (top right): closer: the armchair in a front three-quarter view filling the right half, the fig plant and side table beside it, light on the fabric. Panel 3 (bottom left): detail: low close view of the jacquard pattern on the arm, the piped seam, the walnut base and a tapered leg with its brass tip on the oak floor. Panel 4 (bottom right): a woman, seen from the shoulders down only, sits curled in the armchair with an open book and a mug, bare feet tucked up, the cushion pressed down under her weight. The room, window, light direction and armchair stay the same in all four panels. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real crumbs, dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
